intro: I am a Mechanical Engineering student at the University of Colorado Boulder with hands-on experience in manufacturing, fabrication, and testing.

I spent three summers as a manufacturing technician at Fiberlok Technologies and one as a fabrication intern at Hueber Industries, and I am currently a teaching assistant for CU Boulder's Engineering Projects course. I am looking for mechanical, manufacturing, and test engineering internships for Summer 2027.

paragraphs: I am a Mechanical Engineering student at the University of Colorado Boulder, pursuing a minor in Business through the Leeds School of Business. I am currently a teaching assistant for CU Boulder's Engineering Projects course and a member of the Formula SAE team, where I work on the electric-vehicle powertrain and chassis subsystems.

Most of what I know about building things started on the production floor. I spent three summers as a manufacturing technician at Fiberlok Technologies, where I ran the screens department on my own and helped improve my department's productivity by 30%. I also spent a summer as a fabrication intern at Hueber Industries, machining and welding metal structures from engineering drawings. That experience taught me to think about how a part will be made and assembled while I am still designing it.

Outside of coursework, I build projects that teach me something I did not know before, and I usually learn the most from testing a design and iterating on what the data shows. Across all of my coursework, professional experience, and projects, my primary goal is always to learn as much as I can and apply that knowledge in meaningful ways.
When I am not working on engineering projects, I enjoy woodworking, pottery, hiking, climbing, and nature photography.
